test_check_relevance_is_relevant: test the check_relevance function to verify it returns True when the atomic fact is relevant to the prompt
test_check_relevance_is_not_relevant: test the check_relevance function to verify it returns False when the atomic fact is not relevant to the prompt
test_check_relevance_not_parseable: test the check_relevance function to verify it assumes relevance when the model response is not parseable
test_revise_fact_base: test the revise_fact function to verify it returns a revised self-contained atomic fact from the model response
test_main: test the main function to verify it revises the fact and checks relevance in the correct order
